en: Black‑and‑white interior view of an elegant museum or gallery room with parquet flooring, ornate ceiling moldings, and tall windows. The room contains multiple glass display cases on light-colored wooden tables showing small artifacts and documents, framed paintings on the walls, and several sculptures, including a prominent standing female statue at the back. On the right stands a large tiled stove or fireplace typical of Central or Northern European interiors. There is some handwritten numbering along the left edge of the image.
